# Kotlin codegen for map<K,V> for-loop: emits for ((k, v) in m) { ... }

sngl compile --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=out app.sngl
exists out/MainScreen.kt

# Handler contains a destructuring for-in loop over a map.
grep 'for .* in ' out/MainScreen.kt

-- app.sngl --
output { kotlin { android } }

component main {
    var scores map<string, int> = {alice = 10, bob = 20}
    var total = 0
    button(text="sum", @click {
        for k, v = scores {
            total = total + v
        }
    })
    text(value=string(total))
}
